name: Marsa Matruh

queries.query: Marsa Matruh Egypt official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) as the national surveying/cadastral-map custodian and its official digital-map service page. The official page documents purchasable digital maps and an ASP.NET scale selector, but no public parcel viewer or anonymous parcel geometry API was exposed. Official General Organization for Physical Planning material identified a Matrouh infrastructure/GIS mapping effort, not a parcel service.

queries.query: مرسى مطروح مصر خريطة كادسترية سجل عقاري أراضي جهاز مدينة مرسى مطروح
queries.result: البحث العربي الرسمي وجد الهيئة المصرية العامة للمساحة، وخدمة طلب بيان مساحي حكومية، ومراجع محافظة مطروح/هيئة التخطيط العمراني. لم يظهر عارض قطع أراضٍ عام أو واجهة API مجهولة تعيد هوية قطعة وهندستها. صفحة الهيئة تذكر الخرائط الرقمية وخرائط الملكية تاريخياً، لكنها تعرض مسار شراء الخرائط الرقمية لا تنزيل طبقة قطع عامة.

registryEvidence.custodian: Egyptian Survey Authority (هيئة المساحة المصرية), national survey and map custodian; local Matrouh municipal/GIS references were found but no local public parcel registry endpoint was evidenced.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: ESA first-party pages establish national surveying and digital-map services, while GOPP establishes a Matrouh infrastructure/GIS coordination effort. Neither establishes an anonymous city parcel layer with stable native IDs and polygons. General property/legal service pages were not treated as a local parcel API.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted or used as a citywide absence test.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200. Official ESA homepage states its historical role in cadastral/property maps and records, but no parcel API or viewer route was exposed in the HTML.

HTTP 200. Official digital-map page exposes an ASP.NET form with map scales 1:50000, 1:2500, and 1:5000 and explains that digital GIS/CAD/PDF/JPG/orthophoto products are requested and purchased. No public parcel layer, schema, CRS, native ID, or geometry endpoint was present.

Bounded anonymous POST selecting the 1:2500 scale returned HTTP 200 but the same purchase-information page with no parcel result, ID, geometry, or service configuration. No further form submission or payment/contact workflow was attempted.

HTTP 200. Official GOPP article describes review of Matrouh infrastructure maps with a governorate GIS/planning committee; no parcel viewer, service URL, schema, CRS, ID, or geometry endpoint was exposed.

TLS certificate expired during direct curl verification; request was not accepted and TLS verification was not disabled. Search evidence describes a public service requiring province/area selection, but no response schema or parcel geometry was obtained. This transport failure is not evidence of cadastral absence.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if publicly exposed and source-proven
uncertainty: No official public parcel viewer JavaScript/configuration or anonymous parcel API was identified.
ESA digital-map access appears to be a request/purchase workflow, so parcel schema, CRS, native identity semantics, and geometry availability remain unverified.
Official Matrouh GIS/planning references are infrastructure/planning evidence, not proof of a public cadastral parcel layer.
No parcel polygon is retained because no safe native identity and unchanged full geometry were verified.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter or runtime qualification.
